0.original: The Whilom River's new inhabitants are too much for this hunter to bear.

1.original: A burly gang of bears has taken up residence upstream of the Whilom River. A troubled hunter has asked you to scare them away so that he might resume his hunting. Slay four bears to send the rest running to a new watering hole.

2.original: Four bears now lie at the bottom of the Whilom River. Return to the hunter and tell him of the slaughter.

3.original: The hunter seems relieved, but says he must wait for supplies and a change of weather before he resumes his work. Hopefully no more bears decide to return in the meantime.

48.original: Have you been upstream of the Whilom River yet? Used to be prime huntin' grounds...that is, till the bears moved in.

49.original: Used to be we would hide in the waterfall's basin and lie in wait till a chocobo came 'round for a drink. It was easy pickin's, it was... But the bears are makin' it difficult.

50.original: Someone needs to send them runnin' so we can get back to huntin'─and you look capable enough! Send four down to the bottom of the basin and I'll make it worth your while.

51.original: We haven't been able to catch a single bird since the bears moved in upstream. Take down four of them and I'll make sure you're rewarded.

52.original: I wager those bears regret gettin' in the way of our huntin' now! All that's left is to restock on supplies and wait till it gets a li'l warmer and we can move back upstream.
